correctness.rationale: Every orientation mask among 32768 is tested by both topological peeling and an independently enumerated 57-simple-cycle criterion. All 16384 even-weight Walsh character sums are explicitly calculated directly and agree with a full integer Walsh-Hadamard transform; all odd-weight terms vanish by reversal. Rank 13656, 19112 zeros, exact 105 pair correlations, and full projection kernel with absolute sum 1113888 are verified by code and two certificates. Translation averaging proves the norm 34809/1024 is the unrestricted minimum; the proof does not extrapolate beyond Petersen.

value.rationale: Petersen is the canonical smallest cubic graph of girth five and a standard counterexample for many graph-theoretic phenomena. This exact Fourier classification separates structural reversal-forced zeros (16384) from 2728 additional spectral losses, identifies nontrivial three-shell edge-sign dependence with fifteen exactly uncorrelated maximally separated edge pairs, and determines the sharp unconditional endpoint stability of recovery onto the acyclic-orientation convolution range. The invariants are not implied by counting 16680 orientations, are defined without arbitrary parameter slicing, and provide reference data for signed-orientation Fourier analysis of highly symmetric graphs.
